sources.title: Python 3.12 Tutorial: Data Structures
sources.evidence: Calling list.sort changes that list in place and returns no new list.

claims.text: Calling list.sort changes that list in place and returns no new list.
Sorting with list.sort mutates the original list instead of creating a separate result.
